summary: A high-performance personal portfolio website featuring a minimalist monochrome design and optimized project showcases. It is built using React, TypeScript, and Vite, with a focus on SEO, accessibility, and rapid asset delivery.

components.name: Navigation and Layout
components.purpose: Provides the global header, footer, and routing structure for the application.

components.name: Project Showcase
components.purpose: Displays individual projects via cards and detailed case study pages.

components.name: Resume Preview System
components.purpose: Provides a high-resolution WebP preview of the PDF resume generated at build time.

components.name: SEO and Metadata Management
components.purpose: Manages dynamic meta tags, JSON-LD structured data, and sitemaps for search engine optimization.

components.name: User Feedback
components.purpose: Handles toast notifications for user interactions.

decisions: Uses createBrowserRouter instead of traditional BrowserRouter for React Router v7 compatibility.
Implements build-time PDF rendering to WebP to ensure fast in-page resume previews without client-side heavy lifting.
Uses a centralized slugify helper in projects.ts to ensure URL consistency across the app.
Configures Netlify headers for security (XSS, Frame Options) and explicit MIME type handling.
risks: Client-side lazy loading of project pages may cause a momentary layout shift or loading state visibility.
The resume rendering script depends on @napi-rs/canvas which requires specific system binaries.
Heavy reliance on local state for navigation (targetId) via location.state might lead to unexpected behavior if deep links are used.

hooks.why: How does the build-time PDF-to-WebP conversion handle font embedding and large scale rendering?
How is the slugification logic tested to ensure it matches the routing expected by react-router-dom?
Why was the decision made to adopt the new router object pattern now rather than waiting for the upgrade?
The scroll listener logic for 'activeSection' updates: how do you prevent performance degradation on high-frequency scroll events?
Why was it necessary to explicitly define Content-Type for .mjs and .wasm files in the deployment config?
Since SEO tags are managed via react-helmet-async, how do you ensure search crawlers see the JSON-LD structured data?
The manual calculation of headerOffset: how do you ensure this remains accurate if the header height changes?
The use of Suspense with SectionLoader: how do you balance the granularity of code splitting against the number of loading states the user sees?
